info.name: KHOJ — Broker Callback API
info.description:
Backend API for the tenant-side broker verification agent.

Setup:
1. `npm start` in the khoj folder.
2. Import this collection.
3. Run the requests top to bottom (1a turns pasted text into listings you can feed to 1) — `runId` and `callId` are captured automatically.

The `baseUrl` and `webhookSecret` variables default to a local server with the shipped `.env`. Change `webhookSecret` if you changed `CALLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

Note: `GET /api/runs/:id/events` is a Server-Sent Events stream. Postman does not render SSE well — use a browser tab or `curl -N` for that one.

request.description: Confirms the server is up and tells you which dialer is active. Check this before demoing — it is how you avoid running the mock when you meant to run live calls.

body.raw:
{
  "text": "Hi, saw these on 99acres and a friend sent a few:

2BHK Kondapur, 28,000 + 3 months deposit. Broker Ramesh 9876543210
Gachibowli 3BHK - asking 30000 - +91 98765 43211 (Suresh)
Madhapur, ask for Latha: 098765-43212, rent 26k, no brokerage
Office landline 040-23456789 - don't call this one
Also 98765 43213 in Kothrud, she said 24,000 negotiable
Available from 2026-09-14, budget max 35000"
}

request.description:
Paste anything - a portal copy-paste, a WhatsApp forward, your own notes - and get back listings shaped for POST /api/runs. Feed the `listings` array straight into request 1.

The phone numbers come from a deterministic scan, never from the model: a wrong number means calling a stranger. The model only attaches rent and locality to numbers already found in your text, and any number it returns that is not in the text is dropped.

This sample deliberately includes a landline, four rents and a date. Expect exactly four mobiles and none of the noise.

Without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY you still get every number, with `enriched: false` - a paste is never wasted.

Creates a run and starts dialling immediately.

The four phone numbers are deliberately written four different ways — bare, leading zero, spaced with +91, hyphenated. All four should normalise to E.164.

Captures `runId` into a collection variable.

The whole results table, already ranked: shortlist first, then cheapest, then best-evidenced.

Run this a few times while a run is in flight to watch `finished` climb. Captures the first row's `callId`.

`run.stats.decisive` is the completion metric — a fifteen-second confirmed-dead call counts as a success, not a failure.

The drill-down: full transcript with per-turn timestamps, plus the extraction.

Look at `extraction.evidence` — every field carries the broker's exact words and the audio offsets they were said at. That is what makes click-a-cell-and-hear-it possible, and it is the reason a hallucinated value cannot survive: a quote that is not literally in the transcript is discarded before it ever reaches this response.

exec: console.log('No extraction — set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env and run request 4.');

request.description:
Re-runs extraction over the stored transcript. Places no call; costs one Claude request.

Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. This is the extraction dev loop — change the prompt in src/core/extract.ts, hit this, see the new result.

exec: console.log('No transcript stored for this call — pick an answered one from request 2.');

request.description: Stops the run and cancels every in-flight provider call. To see it do something, create a run with 40 listings and hit this while it is dialling.
Picks up every call still queued. State lives in SQLite, so this also recovers a run whose server process died mid-flight.
Flat CSV of the ranked table, including the evidence quotes as columns.

request.description:
This is exactly what CALL-E will POST when a call finishes — the mock dialer posts to this same route.

To use it, run the server with `DIALER=manual` so calls park in `dialing` instead of completing instantly. Then: create a run, GET the run to grab a `callId`, and fire this.

Expect `{ ok: true, result: 'ok' }`. Then GET the call (request 3) to see the transcript and, with an API key set, the extracted fields with their evidence quotes.

exec: console.log('Call was not in `dialing` — it already finished. Use DIALER=manual to park calls.');

item.name: Webhook · duplicate delivery is a no-op

request.description:
Send this straight after the previous request. Providers retry webhooks, so a second delivery for the same call must not overwrite the transcript or spend a second Claude call.

Expect `result: 'duplicate'`. Then GET the call again — the rent should still be thirty-two thousand, not fifty.

Schedules one retry, `RETRY_DELAY_MIN` minutes out. When every remaining call is waiting on a retry the run parks in `awaiting_retry` rather than spinning, and wakes itself on a timer.

Set `RETRY_DELAY_MIN=1` in `.env` if you want to watch that happen without waiting half an hour.

Anyone who can reach your tunnel can POST here. Without signature verification a stranger could inject fabricated broker answers into your results table.

Expect 401.

item.name: Validation · bad phone number is rejected

request.description:
The whole run is rejected rather than silently dropping the bad row. A listing that vanishes without explanation is worse than an error — the seeker would never know a number was never called.

Expect 400 naming listing 2.
